鉄道駅

A large railway site known for contested valuable loot.

遊び方

Search the tracks for trains. Anyone can drive one with Fuel Bottles, and both cargo holds are unlocked.

主な報酬

The station has valuable loot; train cargo is worth checking, but trains do not spawn at a fixed station point.

危険

Expect player fights. Moving trains can hurt people on the tracks, where building is forbidden.

Recycler

For recycling, visit a gas station, parking lot, town, warehouse, Lumberjack or Miner.
